about_the_game:
STORY:

Player controls Pirate guy whose mission is to finish levels and find treasure. Finding treasure will finish levels and gives player steam achievements. Pirate guy need avoid shooting cannons and several different enemies. There is skeleton and mini shark enemies. Those can be killed by jumping on top of their heads. Then there are greenlight immortal skeleton which need avoid. Player cant kill that enemy. During levels player can collect health pickups and green diamonds which gives player immortality for short period. Some levels contain also moving platforms and every level there is limited time to finish level so you need also be fast and avoid same time enemies and traps

Game contains also 3 boss levels there are big shark boss, which can be killed by jumping 3 times  on top of his head. Shark boss will be sometime get greenlight when he is immortality and he is running same time, so then you need just avoid boss and wait when immortality is lost. So can you be biggest pirate in planet and find all treasuries

FEATURES:

  • 9 different levels. 6 normal levels and 3 boss levels

  • Finish normal levels and find treasure chest to finish and collect steam achievements

  • health pickups

  • When die player respawn to start

  • green diamonds which will give immortality for a while

  • Shooting cannons

  • different enemies, normal skeleton, immortal skeleton, mini shark

  • Boss levels contain shark boss need jump 3 times  on top of his head

  • walling to water or gorge will kill player
